Property Reference: 2856420.

Stylish 1-Bedroom Apartment – Garrett Mansions, W2. Ready to move in today !

 A spacious and beautiful 1-bedroom apartment of Garrett Mansions with great view. The property offers a bright open-plan living space with a private balcony, high-spec Siemens/Miele kitchen, double bedroom, modern bathroom, and comes fully furnished with high quality furniture  and comfort cooling.

 Residents enjoy exclusive access to a gym, swimming pool, cinema, private dining and lounge areas, conference rooms, and 24-hour concierge. Ready to move in today. 

 

 Available now – contact us to arrange a viewing.

Summary & Exclusions:
- Rent Amount: £3,470.00 per month (£800.77 per week)
- Deposit / Bond: £4,003.84
- 1 Bedrooms
- 1 Bathrooms
- Property comes furnished
- Available to move in from 29 August 2026
- Maximum number of tenants is 2
- Students welcome to enquire
- Smokers considered
- Bills not included
- No Parking Available
- No Garden Access
- EPC Rating: B

  If calling, please quote reference: 2856420  

Fees:
You will not be charged any admin fees.

 ** Contact today to book a viewing and have the landlord show you round! ** 
Request Details form responded to 24/7, with phone bookings available 9am-9pm, 7 days a week.
